    Library

    Sources and private material

    This directory retains useful private substance beyond the maintained public philosophy. The distributed package contains this guide; the situated package selects material from the actual person's environment and authorized sources.

    Relevant material can include current work, study, research, and life purposes; psychological or relational experience; and evidence of environmental use. Keep a useful distillation with source, date, and consequential uncertainty, or a direct route to the original when that suffices. Current public philosophy and its owning source supply the conceptual account. Refresh private summaries from it and retire duplicated theory, superseded interpretations, and material that no longer helps. Public and private distinguish disclosure, not authorship.

    sources.md locates source owners and collections; topic notes here carry necessary private detail and its provenance. The actual encounter, user model, counterpart and relationship, and use remain in their own files. Proactively maintain affected material during relevant work under the maintenance method. Originals and extended history retain their existing source owners; they need not remain duplicated in every active package. The shared package must not reproduce a private portrait or source index.
